Smoky Soot. Dark Chocolate. Peppermint.


Aroma

TASTE

Finish


This elegant, unbelievably complex dram leaves ripples of coffee grounds and liquorice on the tongue long after its peaty tide goes out.

Exploding into a dazzlingly sweet spray of everything from chocolate and coffee to menthol, spice, and fruit. The mouthfeel is slightly oily, and is followed by an intense, minty sweetness, along with some toasting bread, creosote, coal tar soap and even a whiff of smoked pineapple. The deep, rich, flavours continue, with dark chocolate, peppermint creams, bonfire embers and camphor.

Subtly shifting in character with each annual bottling, Traigh Bhan is as bracingly unpredictable as the Islay weather. Typically expect gusts of herbs and fennel mingling in a breeze of citrus, followed by a sudden tidal wave of smoke.

![Image](https://www.ardbeg.com/cdn/shop/files/Ardbeg-19-TB06-Bottle_Pack.png?v=1770979589&width=481)

SHIFTING SANDS

ARDBEG 19 YEARS OLD TRAIGH BHAN BATCH 6


From the Ardbeg Distillery to Port Ellen and beyond, follow the rocky coast and you will discover the heavenly vista of Traigh Bhan (pronounced tri-van), the beautiful beach known locally as the Singing Sands…

Incredibly rare, this small batch 19 Year Old Ardbeg greets the senses with a delicate aroma of olive oil Curious hints of freshly cut grass, ginger and soot swish on the nose. Fresh peppermint and baked bread cascade into classic Ardbeg flavours with creosote, dark chocolate, and the distant whiff of bonfire. A long finish carries rich ripples of coffee and liquorice that slowly ebb away.
